description: Queries an eCW FHIR server using OAuth 2.0 JWT-bearer authentication with a separate token endpoint and pushes each returned resource downstream as JSON.

config.label: Interval
config.description: How often, in milliseconds, the runtime invokes the polling script.

config.label: Base URL
config.description: Root URL of the eCW FHIR endpoint. Resource paths are appended to it, so a trailing slash is expected (one is added if omitted).

config.label: Auth URL
config.description: Root URL of the eCW OAuth server. The token endpoint path oauth/oauth2/token is appended to it. This is separate from the FHIR base URL.

config.label: Client ID
config.description: The client ID assigned when the app was registered with eCW.

config.label: Private Key Path
config.description: Absolute path to the PEM-encoded RSA private key whose public key is registered with eCW. Used to sign the RS384 JWT client assertion.

config.label: Key ID
config.description: The key identifier (kid) placed in the JWT header. Must match the key ID registered with eCW for your public key.

config.label: Scopes
config.description: OAuth scopes to request. Space-separated. eCW requires scopes on the token request (unlike Epic). Defaults to system/Patient.read system/Medication.read system/Encounter.read if left empty.

config.label: Resource Type
config.description: FHIR resource type to search on each poll, for example Patient, Encounter or Observation.

config.label: Search Query
config.description: Search parameters as a URL query string, for example family=Smith&birthdate=1970-01-01. Leave empty to search without filters.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, FHIR requests are simulated and no data leaves the runtime. Authentication is always performed live so credential problems surface immediately.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Whether to verify the eCW server's TLS certificate. Leave on outside of local testing.
